verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded payments platform for marketplaces, so agent-initiated checkout is a fair question for it. The evidence documents amount splits, stored payment methods, and short-lived component sessions. None of it covers agentic-commerce protocols, delegated payment credentials for AI agents, or agent-initiated checkout. Those adjacent features do not count as delivering the story.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform is ready for agent buyers — documented support for agent-initiated checkout on marketplace transactions (agentic-commerce protocols, delegated payment credentials) that works with split funds flows
